sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edges across today's card. Tuesday these went 1-1. Today centers on WNBA Finals Game 3, where two sources agree on the Valkyries with points.

straight.reasoning: SI and Yahoo both take Golden State. The Valkyries are 7-3 against the spread as road underdogs, and Atlanta is just 10-13 against the spread as a home favorite. Game 2 swung on Atlanta shooting 35 free throws to 19 and forcing 19 turnovers, and Golden State had the league's second-lowest turnover rate going in. Yahoo's model projects Atlanta by only 1.5. We were on Golden State +4.5 in the semis and it won outright. Playable to +3; skip at +2.5.
Game 1 totaled 132 and Game 2 finished well under this number too. Neither team has shot 30% from three in this series. Late fouling is the risk. RG.org's pick. Skip if the line drops below 148.

parlay.title: Grind-It-Out Game 3 (SGP)
parlay.reasoning: A low-scoring, close game is the setup that suits Golden State's defense best. Correlated legs, so the book will pay less than shown.

sections.label: Soccer
sections.slate: Champions League: Arsenal @ Bayern Munich at 12:00 PM PT. Bayern is without the suspended Michael Olise.

straight.reasoning: Arsenal has been the tightest defense in the Champions League, and Bayern is missing Olise, its main creator. Arsenal's price has drifted up all week. RG.org's pick. A quarter unit, since Bayern's attack at home is dangerous. Skip below +210.

sections.label: Hockey
sections.slate: Wednesday card includes Panthers @ Senators (4:30 PM PT).

straight.reasoning: Ottawa's offense has been struggling, and Florida allows few shots. Plus money on the Under. Check Florida's goalie, since it's the second night of a back-to-back. RG.org's pick. Skip if it moves to -120.

Minnesota has the better defense, and plus money for the better team is the value. RG.org's pick. Miami's pace at home is the risk.
